state.verified_context: At commit 99a53f93d2e3cccd392a6f328b5347e7d96b3128, Feedback publicly grants only present approved suggestion text/category/status/response under a published Product. Submission and author revision both enter a hidden review state. Responsible owners can change roadmap fields in that state and later approve them. Authors/owners retain private audit access; voter accounts never enter the aggregate public report. Audit rendering uses today's readable fields rather than approval of each historical revision. Consequently public generic history is insufficient to prevent rejected content disclosure. The requirement still needs both public operator decisions and an on-page Product choice. Existing language designs provide contained private records, locked fields, atomic writes, optional record links, explicit authority reports with structural results, pure viewer reads, and typed filters/defaults over collection values. All are draft targets, not an implemented execution engine. Approved history must support removing unsafe past text while retaining owner evidence, and be inaccessible while its parent is hidden/archived or the product unpublished. Previously downloaded text cannot be revoked.
state.history_options: A stores each roadmap submission in a private immutable Decision child and points Suggestion.current_decision at it. The child keeps status, response, nullable release instant and irreversible withdrawal state/reason. Updating an unhidden suggestion releases the new snapshot; updating a hidden one leaves it private. Owner unhide releases just the pointed-to draft; abandoned hidden drafts never become public. Hiding temporarily blocks all public history, while explicit reapproval permits previously released entries again. A nonpublished Product additionally suppresses reading, but staff changes to an approved suggestion are intentionally publication-ready for when that Product is published. Withdrawing a noncurrent entry suppresses it alone. Withdrawing the current entry atomically hides the suggestion and resets its current pointer, status to proposed, response and duplicate so it needs a new review. A closed authority query returns released, unwithdrawn status/response/release-time only, with active ancestor checks and no raw audit, private identity or contributor revision. B instead groups public snapshots by review period and permanently excludes every earlier period after the next approval; storage/control is simpler but ordinary contributor edits break the public decision narrative. C adds historical release and redaction rules to the generic audit facility, reducing dedicated business records while expanding shared runtime semantics.
state.selector_options: A projects authorized Products through an ordinary viewer derive to a nonstored ProductChoice value containing the Product reference, name and nullable location. Existing collection reference/location filters initialize from preferences; name is searchable. Forms receive explicit record/parent/product arguments from that value. The preference's former mandatory WHERE is removed, so local selection/clear can override its initial default. No extra business command, preference auto-save or new presentation syntax is introduced; there is small projection duplication and the normal complete-or-error work budget. B defines a new self-record collection filter and its corresponding JS metadata, making a Product collection filter its own identity while preserving row nesting. This is concise at the app site but adds a language/UI contract. Both alternatives preserve authorized lookup, contextual guards and private/public page separation.

history.instructions: Select the most suitable of these approaches for a finite safe-history design: balance privacy, owner retention, useful cross-review history and implementation complexity without claiming execution evidence.

criteria.A: Maintain ordinary private decision records, explicitly release the current one, withdraw entries permanently, and expose a closed report.
criteria.B: Expose only the latest moderation epoch and keep all earlier decision periods private thereafter.
criteria.C: Teach the shared audit system about per-revision publication and selective redaction.

selector.instructions: For this focused Feedback change, which way of providing the Product choice gives the better tradeoff between source simplicity and additional contract surface?

criteria.A: Project Product into a small structural row and reuse its existing typed reference filter with initial preference defaults.
criteria.B: Specify a new self-identity filter meaning for a model collection and a matching shared target representation.
